name: Neck Curl
instructions: Lie face up on a bench with your head just off the end, or sit and place your hand on your forehead for light resistance.
Slowly tuck your chin toward your chest against the light resistance.
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A gentle neck-flexion exercise that strengthens the muscles at the front of the neck.

safetyNotes: Neck exercises need very light loads; stop with any dizziness, tingling or pain.
